in_sanskrit.name: भूषण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: bhū-śaṇa-m (bhū-bhū- śaṇa-m) भू-शण-म् भू- Bhū- (bhū-bhū- bhū-bhū- in Sanskrit means ‘that which is’; शण-म् शण-m is the suffix that denotes an object or a thing, and भू-शण-म् bhū-śaṇa-m, thus, means ‘that which is an ornament’; ornament or decoration.
